faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

q1.question: How does Ceremly work?
q1.answer: Create your event, upload your guest list and choose how to send them: 1-click email or WhatsApp deep link. Guests confirm in a second and you monitor everything from the dashboard.

q2.question: Do I need technical skills?
q2.answer: Absolutely not. The interface is designed to be intuitive. Create your event and send invites in less than 5 minutes.

q3.question: Do WhatsApp deep links use bots?
q3.answer: No, no bots. The system generates a link that opens your WhatsApp app with a pre-filled message. You simply press send. Totally personal and safe.

q4.question: Is guest data safe?
q4.answer: Absolutely. We use standard encryption, are GDPR compliant and data is automatically deleted after the event if requested.

q5.question: Can I try before paying?
q5.answer: Join the waitlist for priority access and a lifetime discount. Early users will also get a free month of Pro.

q6.question: When will Ceremly launch?
q6.answer: We're working on the launch. Join the waitlist to be among the first to try the platform and receive updates.
